Name: Buffs Last
Author: aceynk
Description:
[b][size=5]Buffs Last[/size][/b]
Buffs Last is a SMAPI (c#) mod that makes ALL buffs (hopefully) persist through occurrences that normally remove them, such as sleeping and saving/loading a save.

A config option exists to prevent buffs that last indefinitely (some 1.6 buffs) from lasting through days. Thanks to @rainbowlack's girlfriend for the patch!

Buffs Last is open source: [url=https://github.com/aceynk/Buffs-Last/]https://github.com/aceynk/Buffs-Last/[/url]
[size=4]
[b]Dependencies[/b][/size]
Requires SMAPI ([url=https://smapi.io/]https://smapi.io/[/url])
Requires PersistentBuffs ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25593]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25593[/url])
